dashboard.scheduledMoments: Your scheduled moments for the day.
dashboard.riskWindowDescription: Your next planned moment is {timeToNext}. You have a plan. You can do this.
dashboard.riskWindowMissedYesterday: You missed a moment yesterday. Your next risk is {timeToNext}. Today is a new chance.
dashboard.riskWindowSmokedToday: One moment logged. The chain is only as strong as the next link, which is {timeToNext}. You can break it here.
dashboard.riskWindowNoMoments: No upcoming risk windows today. Well done on completing your plan.

financials.title: Financials
financials.description: Every dollar not spent is a dollar invested in your freedom.
financials.description_positive: A day of perfect savings. This isn't just money; it's reclaimed time, health, and freedom.
financials.description_negative: Is this fleeting relief truly worth the price? Each dollar spent is a vote for the addiction.
financials.net_debt: This isn't savings; it's a debt. You've borrowed from tomorrow's health for today's fleeting urge. The bill will come due.
financials.net_zero: You broke even. A hard-fought battle with no ground lost. Tomorrow, we take territory.
financials.net_low: A small surplus. A single step in the right direction. Now, take another.
financials.net_moderate: This is a real surplus. You won the day. This feeling is what freedom tastes like. Savor it.
financials.net_high: Look at this number. This isn't just money; it's reclaimed time, health, and freedom. You are buying back your life.
financials.net_no_baseline: Set your daily average in your profile to see your net savings calculated against your baseline.

progress.title: Habit Progress
progress.description_perfect: A perfect day. You chose freedom every time. Rejoice in this victory.
progress.description_good: You won more than you lost today. Each skipped cigarette is a step out of the trap.
progress.description_progress: Progress, not perfection. You proved you don't need it. Build on this.
progress.description_lesson: Today was a lesson, not a failure. What did you learn from each moment?
progress.description_default: Your success in skipping planned smokes.

replacementReport.title: Replacement Report
replacementReport.description_encouragement_1: Yes. This is how you reclaim your time. The first step is the hardest and you've taken it.
replacementReport.description_encouragement_2: Each replacement is a vote for a new you. You're casting multiple votes today. Keep going.
replacementReport.description_encouragement_3: This is it. You're not just 'not smoking,' you're actively living. This is what winning looks like.
replacementReport.description_encouragement_4: Keep this up for 3 days to build confidence. Keep it up for 21 days to build a new habit. You are on your way.
replacementReport.description_encouragement_5: Excellent choice. Freedom is built one decision at a time.
replacementReport.description_encouragement_6: This is the path. Every time you choose a replacement, you weaken the addiction's hold on you.
replacementReport.description_empty_1: Your best weapon against an urge is a plan. What's one positive action you'll choose next time?
replacementReport.description_empty_2: An opportunity awaits. The next urge isn't a threat; it's a chance to make a better choice.
replacementReport.description_empty_3: No replacements logged yet. Let's change that. What will you do instead of smoking next time?
replacementReport.no_replacements_day: No replacements logged for this day. Other logs available.
replacementReport.no_replacements_yet: Skip a smoke to log a replacement!

replacementMood.title: Replacement Moods
replacementMood.description_positive: The dominant feeling was positive. This is the reward you give yourself.
replacementMood.description_calm: You found peace without it. This proves the cigarette is not the source of calm.
replacementMood.description_uneasy: Feeling uneasy is normal. It's the addiction fighting back. You are stronger.
replacementMood.description_default: How you felt after choosing a better path on {date}.
replacementMood.description_empty: No replacement moods logged today. Every urge is a chance to build a new feeling.

moodReport.title: Mood Analysis
moodReport.no_moods: No moods logged today. A blank slate is a victory in itself.
moodReport.description_stressed: Stress was the trigger. But smoking doesn't relieve stress, it causes it. You are breaking the cycle.
moodReport.description_bored: Boredom is a common illusion. The cigarette didn't entertain you, it just passed the time.
moodReport.description_happy: You reached for a cigarette when you were already happy. Remember that joy comes from within, not from a smoke.
moodReport.description_guilty: The main feeling afterward was guilt. The cigarette promised relief but left regret. It lied.
moodReport.description_same: You felt the same after. The habit offered no real change. Remember this emptiness.
moodReport.description_default: Your feelings before & after smoking on {date}.

trendChart.title: 30-Day Trend
trendChart.description_higher_1: A tough day, well above your average. It happens. Reflect on what was different today. Don't let one day define the journey.
trendChart.description_higher_2: A bit more than usual. A small deviation, not a disaster. What were the triggers? Let's be ready for them tomorrow.
trendChart.description_lower: A good day, well below your average. This is progress. This is strength. Build on this momentum.
trendChart.description_win: Look at this. A day of control, discipline, and success. This is proof you can do it.
trendChart.description_zero_1: Zero. This is a massive win against a daily average of {avg}. This is proof you can do it.
trendChart.description_zero_2: Zero smokes logged today. An amazing achievement! Keep this momentum going.

patternChart.title: Daily Pattern
patternChart.description_default: Your habit pattern by hour, based on the last 30 days.
patternChart.description_peak: Your peak time is between {start} and {end}. Awareness is the first step to changing it.
patternChart.description_spread: No clear peak in your usage times. Your habit seems evenly spread throughout the day.

logDialog.title: How are you feeling?
logDialog.description: Select the primary emotion you feel right now. This helps you identify triggers.
logDialog.moment_recorded_desc: Your moment of awareness has been logged. One last thing...

replaceDialog.title: Replace this Moment
replaceDialog.description: Log a positive action and how it made you feel. This is a huge win.

plan.no_moments: No moments planned. Add one to get started!
plan.info_description: Create a plan for your day. For each moment, you can log that you smoked or that you chose a positive replacement activity.
